title: Correct one emotional understanding while keeping support context specific

turns.user: For this work presentation, I feel sad and I want you to listen first. Please remember a separate emotional understanding of this situation: my feeling, your tentative interpretation, listening as the support approach, and that advice is welcome when I ask.

Correction about that same work presentation: I feel anxious, not sad. Please revise the same emotional understanding rather than adding a second one. Listening first still helps; advice is welcome only when I ask.

reply.judge: Accepts the correction to anxious and listening first. Does not diagnose or turn a presentation-specific feeling into a permanent personality trait.
